details:
Details about this request:

The feature should work like this, any person you block will be shown as a Diamond and their name will be change with "Blocked User" you will not be able to see their avatar neither hear their voice, people who block you should say "Blocked by the user". In the launch pad in settings there should be a category that let you change the opacity of the diamond and the "Block User" name tag, that way you can fully turn off the diamond or the name tag locally if you like.

The main block at the moment just make the person fully invisible, not existent at all neither their hitbox for you neither for the user, if you and the user are on the same lobby playing a game as example: Murder 4 and this user have you block you won't be able to attack them neither take them down due the hitbox is not existent for either you or the other user, this happend aswell with Prison Escape and few others games aswell. This might help out preventing users abusing the block feature.
title: Block Users shown as Diamond and Vice-versa.
